# PeachPrep RE

> Free Georgia real estate exam prep — a free practice quiz and the PeachPrep RE iOS app with 1,900+ GA-specific practice questions, 400+ flashcards, and full 152-question PSI-style timed simulations.

Exam-format facts on these pages (152 questions = 100 national + 52 Georgia supplement, both portions scored separately at 75%, 4-hour limit, administered by PSI) are verified against the official PSI/GREC candidate information bulletin.

## Study guides & exam facts

- [Georgia Real Estate Exam Vocabulary: 50 Terms You Need to Know](https://peachprepre.com/vocab.html): The 50 most-tested Georgia real estate exam terms — from BRRETA, brokerage engagements, and designated agency to security deeds, the intangible recording tax, and Georgia's power-of-sale foreclosure — with plain-English, exam-focused definitions organized by topic. Includes the Georgia-only concepts national prep material skips.
- [Free Georgia Real Estate Practice Questions](https://peachprepre.com/practice-questions.html): 20 free Georgia real estate exam practice questions with answers and explanations — covering license law, agency, contracts, finance, valuation, and more. National + state portions, no email required.
- [How Many Questions Is the Georgia Real Estate Exam? Format, Time Limit & Passing Score](https://peachprepre.com/exam-facts.html): The Georgia salesperson exam is 152 questions (100 national + 52 Georgia supplement, plus 1–10 unscored experimental items) in one 4-hour sitting — you need 75% on each portion, scored separately with no averaging. Exam fee is $175 per attempt as of July 2026 (many sites still quote the old fee); retakes can be scheduled as soon as two days after a fail. Georgia issues your license at the PSI test center — allow 24 hours after passing, $170 license fee covers the first four years, and you must apply within 12 months of passing. Per the official PSI Georgia Candidate Information Bulletin (July 2026) and the Georgia Real Estate Commission.
- [How Much Does It Cost to Get a Georgia Real Estate License? (2026 Fee Breakdown)](https://peachprepre.com/cost.html): Expect $560–$890 all-in: $205–$520 for the required 75-hour pre-license course, $10–$25 for the GCIC criminal history report (varies by county, must be under 60 days old), the $175 exam fee, and the $170 license fee covering the first four years. Retakes cost the full $175 with no portion discount. A 25-hour post-license course is also required during the first year of licensure.

## Interactive

- [Free Georgia Real Estate Practice Exam](https://peachprepre.com/quiz.html): Take our free 20-question Georgia real estate practice exam. Find your weak spots across key GA exam topics and see exactly where to focus your studying. No email required.
- [Georgia Real Estate Exam Study Guides](https://peachprepre.com/guides.html): Free GA real estate exam study guides. Georgia PSI-specific resources to help you pass on the first try.

## App

- [PeachPrep RE on the App Store](https://peachprepre.com/): iOS app with 1,900+ Georgia-specific practice questions, flashcards, and timed exam simulations — built for the GA PSI salesperson exam. Includes an 11-question FAQ on Georgia exam format, scoring, and difficulty.

## Support
